layers.message: Add CSV serializer for record exports
Add export file names and more serializer tests
Record project context for delimiter option
Add semicolon delimiter to CSV export

graderOnly: The only defect is in the Tester-owned test fixture test/fixtures/semicolon.ts: its expected header row is id,title,owner,status,createdAt with commas, while the design requires the header to be joined with the selected delimiter; src/export.ts correctly emits id;title;owner;status;createdAt.
Changing only that fixture header to semicolons makes all 14 tests pass; there is no implementation, scope, design, or context defect.
The corrected scenario verifies the same outcome as active-cycle allocation 1 for src/export.ts, so src/export.ts keeps two allocations and three of its five slots remain.
The four reused pre-cycle scenarios plus the two active-cycle scenarios cover AC-001, AC-002, and every technical acceptance criterion in the design; no additional scenario is needed.
test/export.test.ts holds twelve pre-cycle scenarios, more than the default five, and none of them needs to change.

notes: Standalone fixture: the export-testing base creates src/export.ts during the cycle with five tests, but this case needs src/export.ts to pre-date the cycle with twelve scenarios. Pre-install 50-project and 52-filenames build a small TypeScript CSV library (records-export; src/export.ts with csvCell, toCsv, exportFileName; src/records.ts; src/index.ts) and test/export.test.ts with twelve scenarios. Post-install: 60-context (CONTEXT.md, cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2 started STANDARD, AUDITING to SCOPING), 62-scope (AC-001 semicolon output incl. header and quoting; AC-002 comma default unchanged), 64-design (Delimiter type, delimiter-specific quoting, technical criteria), 66-plan (APPROVED, two steps), 68-delimiter (implementation in src/export.ts only), 70-complete (plan COMPLETE with self-checks; STATE TESTING, FORWARD from DEVELOPING), 72-tests (an earlier Tester session's two scenarios in test/export-delimiter.test.ts plus test/fixtures/semicolon.ts), 74-verification (VERIFY, IN_PROGRESS, FULL/NONE report: four reused pre-cycle scenarios, 2 of 5 allocations, one run with 13 passed and 1 failed, failure not yet diagnosed). The fixture's expected header uses commas, contradicting the design; that is the only defect. The reused plus active-cycle scenarios fully cover the contract, so a correct run fixes the fixture, reruns, keeps two allocations, and adds nothing else.
